day_shape: 87 items dominated by IRGC claims that four tankers were struck and three hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Netanyahu-Katz 'Iran will burn' regime-change rhetoric, fresh US sanctions on a Greek-Panama law firm, and reports Israeli security officials warned against striking Iran before elections.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker strikes
threads.summary: The IRGC Navy said four vessels transferring oil ship-to-ship were simultaneously struck and caught fire in the Persian Gulf, with three hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Defa Press published satellite imagery and Khamenei's office quoted the Supreme Leader saying foreign powers coveting the Gulf have 'no place there except at the depths of its waters'.

threads.label: Israeli strike planning and regime-change rhetoric
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Netanyahu laid out a directive for the IDF and Mossad to overthrow the Iranian regime with Defence Minister Katz declaring 'Iran will burn', while Times of Israel reported Netanyahu planned strikes earlier this month that Trump opposed before US midterms. Separate reports said Israeli security officials warned against striking Iran now and that IAF jets flew to the Iranian border Monday in a practice sortie.

threads.label: US and allied sanctions enforcement
threads.summary: The US sanctioned a Greek-Panama law firm and shipping operators accused of helping Iran evade oil-export restrictions, Greece said it was implementing Iran-linked sanctions, and Germany's BaFin ordered the liquidation of Bank Saderat Iran's Hamburg branch. Canada ordered deportation of an Iranian man over his role in a sanctions-evasion network.

threads.label: Iran oil, LPG and economic pressure
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran's floating oil reserves have fallen from nearly 90 million barrels to zero, while Iran International reported millions of tons of surplus LPG after the mid-July US naval blockade. Iran's UN ambassador wrote to the Security Council over the maritime blockade and central bank governor Hemmati said $20 billion had been allocated for essential-goods imports.

threads.label: Diplomatic channels and Russia mediation
threads.summary: Trump said the US is not currently negotiating with Iran but 'something' will happen 'soon', while Putin discussed Iran with envoy Steve Witkoff and Lavrov visited Tehran. SNSC secretary Rezai told Defa Press Iran has 'no interest in unsupported agreements' and warned energy markets would not stabilise for three years.

threads.label: Sirik explosions and IRGC weapons claims
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited reports that a US military strike caused earlier explosions in Iran's Sirik, with further explosions heard the same day. The IRGC separately announced preparations to unveil a new weapon dubbed the 'Father of All Bombs' in response to US threats against nuclear facilities, and commanders Hatami and Akhlaghi stressed drone and asymmetric-warfare readiness.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and IDF operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of a Palestinian Islamic Jihad rocket operative and a Hamas sniper in separate Gaza City strikes earlier in the week, naming Abdullah Munir Mahmoud Harz and Muhammad Wael Mustafa Sha'sha'a. A further IAF strike on a 'terrorist' was reported in northern Gaza.

We are actively engaged in production, distribution and maintenance of drones in particular manner and at the same time necessary training has been given to fighters for use of these weapons and we can say we have achieved good maturity in the field of drones and generally in unmanned systems. The special and difficult-to-treat patients fund was established in 1401 and from the start of fund operations, over three million patients have been registered and use its services. The largest number of covered patients are those suffering from various types of cancer. In the first six months of the year, approximately 6.5 trillion has been definitively spent on patient services and close to 2 trillion has also been in documents under review; in total, service commitments of approximately 8.5 trillion have been created.
